seo_desc: Do your videos crash the server or cost a fortune on external platforms? We design a Serverless Cloud HLS streaming API for SMBs and academies.
author_pitch: I have seen dozens of academies and B2B platforms go bankrupt under the weight of abusive video streaming bills or crashed servers. My mission is to build independent, secure, and ultra-fast cloud streaming infrastructures, giving you back total control of your content and your profit margins.
title: Cloud Video Streaming API: Avoid Crashes and Abusive Fees
body:
Are your videos taking forever to load or ruining you with monthly fees?

Online academies, content creators, and B2B platforms face a lethal bottleneck. Hosting videos on your own web server exhausts bandwidth and brings down your page as soon as three users connect at the same time. As a patch, you end up paying thousands of euros to external hosting platforms that limit your growth, hijack your data, and expose your content to piracy or unauthorized downloads, causing you to lose sales and revenue every single day.

The trap of relying on third-party services for your video

Delegating your most valuable asset to standard platforms seems easy, but it chains you to viewing limits, lack of privacy, and unjustified price hikes every year. The content is yours, but the control and profit go to others.

Our solution: Cloud Transcoding and HLS Streaming Infrastructure

At LANZAESTUDIO we design and integrate a Serverless Cloud architecture specifically tailored to process, protect, and deliver your videos on a global scale without relying on third parties. We build a transcoding API that instantly converts your raw files into multiple adaptive resolutions.

  1. Serverless Transcoding: We process your heavy files in the cloud in seconds without affecting your main server.
  2. Adaptive HLS Streaming: Your clients will enjoy smooth playback that automatically adapts to their internet connection, from 480p up to 4K.
  3. DRM Protection and Signatures: We prevent piracy by implementing signed URLs and AES-128 encryption, ensuring that only paying users watch your courses or B2B resources.
  4. Cold and Hot Storage: We optimize costs by storing raw content in affordable databases and serving the final streaming through ultra-fast global CDNs.

The Real Impact on your Courses and B2B Platforms

  • Massive savings in operational costs: You reduce bills by up to 80% by cutting out intermediaries and paying only for the Cloud computing milliseconds you actually use.
  • Zero latency on a global scale: Your videos load instantly anywhere in the world, improving user retention and eliminating complaints about playback interruptions.
  • Total content sovereignty and security: You regain absolute control of your digital assets, shielding them against illegal downloads and protecting your B2B business model in the long term.
